citations.title: Bizagi Cloud Platform > Bizagi's AI approach
excerpts: As a cloud-native platform running on Microsoft Azure, Bizagi leverages Microsoft’s leadership in generative AI by embedding Azure’s Private OpenAI GPT service directly into its automation suite.

Bizagi's AI capabilities leverage AI models provided through Microsoft Azure services. As AI technology continues to evolve, the underlying models available to Bizagi may change over time as newer versions become available, existing versions are updated, or support for specific models is discontinued.
